capability.summary: Extract non-empty text-frame content from each slide in a PPTX file
capability.description: Opens one local presentation with python-pptx, walks slides and shapes in library order, joins non-empty shape text with newlines per slide, and returns slide records in a JSON envelope.
capability.problem_space: Read-only plain-text extraction from text-frame-bearing shapes in PPTX slides; not presentation rendering, OCR, speaker-note extraction, layout preservation, table/media analysis, or PPT/PDF conversion.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing PPTX-compatible presentation. Output: JSON envelope with slide_count and ordered slides [{slide, text}], or a handled open/extraction error.
accepted_inputs: an existing PowerPoint Open XML presentation readable by python-pptx
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "python-pptx", target: string, slide_count: integer, slides: [{slide: integer, text: string}]}, exit 0. Slides without non-empty text-frame shapes have text="". Missing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. Any caught open or extraction exception: {status: "error", tool: "python-pptx", message: string}, exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: extracts only shapes for which python-pptx reports has_text_frame and does not guarantee table-cell text, chart labels, SmartArt, embedded objects, images/OCR, or speaker notes
flattens each slide to newline-joined plain text and does not preserve coordinates, styles, runs, reading order semantics, animations, or hyperlinks
has no timeout, slide/text cap, or output truncation and does not modify the presentation

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing slide count and per-slide newline-joined text-frame content, or a handled extraction error.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: extract text from PPTX slide shapes
summarize slide text by slide number
negative_intents: extract speaker notes tables charts or image OCR comprehensively
preserve PowerPoint layout formatting or reading order
edit render or convert a presentation

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing slide count and per-slide newline-joined text-frame content, or a handled extraction error.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
